                                 TECHNICAL
                     POLICY AND PROCEDURE NOTICE                #3/88


     DATE:       March 10, 1988

     TO:         BOROUGH SUPERINTENDENTS

     FROM:       Deputy Commissioner Cornelius F. Dennis, P.E.

     SUBJECT: Horizontal Venting of Gas Boilers without
               connection to chimney



     Direct vented combustion systems shall be defined as those
     systems receiving fresh air directly from the outside and
     venting the products of combustion directly to the outside
     by means of ducts forming a sealed system.

     These units when installed in compliance with the above may
     be accepted under provisions of Code Section 27-886, as
     being equivalent to the sealed combustion system described
     therein and are therefore not required to comply with the
     chimney or vent requirements of Sub-Chapter 15.

     Existing installations not currently complying with the
     above may be modified. These modifications, designed by the
     professional applicant, shall be accomplished in conjunction
     with the boiler manufacturer so as to be consistent with the
     testing laboratory certifications and follow-up procedures.

     The boilers shall be subject to the acceptance procedure of
     the Materials Equipment & Acceptance Division.
